title: Colts franchise falls to new low of mediocrity after being upset at home by once winless Titans

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts franchise falls to new low of mediocrity after being upset at home by once winless Titans
sources.description: This has got to be one of the worst losses for the Colts franchise in recent memory, and a clear sign of the type of meaningful leadership change that is desperately needed—and arguably long overdue.
